messages.text: Hi Sarah. I can walk through the crown estimate using your demo plan facts.
What will a crown at DEMO_P1 cost if I do it this year?

For DEMO_P1's in-network crown, the demo calculator estimates the plan pays $600.00 and you pay $600.00. Your stored annual maximum remaining is $800.00, so $200.00 would remain afterward. This is a demo estimate, not a claim.
How much dental benefit do I have left?
Your demo annual dental maximum remaining is $800.00. Your stored FSA balance is $350.00. I do not change those balances after an estimate.
